description: Crime Statistics, Victoria is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Crime Statistics Agency, Victoria State Government. Summary statistics, maps and data visualisations on crime in Victoria, produced by the Crime Statistics Agency as part of the Victoria State Government. Data is available on type of offences, victims, and demographic characteristics of alleged offenders. Data is available on local government areas (LGA), postcode and suburb. Data can also be examined on sex, age and Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander status. Coverage is the states and territories, 2014 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
